rejected_legacy_motion.reason: 16-frame cosine oscillation makes head wobble and native pixels crawl; passing per-frame difference is not a sign of quality

intended_tone: calm young urban Vietnamese adult, quietly alive, slightly playful, natural breathing and brief blink

timeline.name: rest_A
timeline.action: held grounded bind pose, natural weight established

timeline.name: inhale_start
timeline.action: shoulder/chest one native pixel of hand-authored upward volume; keep head readable

timeline.name: inhale_hold
timeline.action: one small settled collar/jacket/upper-arm response, no neck swivel

timeline.name: exhale
timeline.action: chest returns smoothly via separately authored clusters, no whole-character slide

timeline.name: rest_B
timeline.action: two-foot grounded hold; duplicate adjacent frames permitted to create dwell

timeline.name: blink_anticipation
timeline.action: tiny eye eyelid pixels only, hair still, no full-head turn

timeline.name: blink_closed
timeline.action: brief natural eyelid shape at 1x, facial landmarks fixed

timeline.name: blink_open
timeline.action: recover smile/eyes; bag and arm unchanged

timeline.name: rest_A_loop
timeline.action: repeat identical first keypose pixel-for-pixel; no jump

authoring_requirements: Art-direct independent editable keypose RGBA native pixels rather than rotating whole 128x160 slabs with inverse nearest sampling
Keep hair contour and facial identity stable; no periodic head sway
Brace both feet on the ground; do not rotate knees or ankles during breathing Idle
For small torso volume changes, manually repair shoulder/elbow seam clusters at every keypose
Bag is coupled to torso, with hand behind satchel in every keypose; strap attachment continuous
Deliberate dwell/rest frames ARE ALLOWED; do not require all consecutive frames to differ
Use no gradient, filter, blur, sprite HD downsampling, or additional views
Export one sheet of distinct KEY POSES and full-duration real-timing playback before reviewing a 16+ frame loop
